mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where RSAFS increases > 1% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines > 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a liquidity trap, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and GDPC1 growth < 0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals strengthening demand, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases > 10% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 jobs in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 70% of instances where PAYEMS > +200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases.
